```{r setup,include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
# Load necessary libraries
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(rsample)
library(randomForest)
library(cluster)
library(factoextra)
library(broom)
```

## Creating Linear Model
```{r}

# Read the CSV file
df <- read.csv("hyrox_results_updated_V4.csv")

# Filter for completed athletes
df_completed <- df %>%
  filter(completed == "Yes")

# Define predictor columns
predictors <- c(
  paste0("run_", 1:8),
  "ski_erg", "sled_push", "sled_pull", "burpee_broad_jumps",
  "rowing", "farmers_carry", "sandbag_lunges", "wall_balls",
  "gender", "nationality", "age_group"
)

# Select and clean data
df_model <- df_completed %>%
  select(all_of(predictors), total_time) %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  mutate(
    gender = as.factor(gender),
    nationality = as.factor(nationality),
    age_group = as.factor(age_group)
  )

# Split into training and testing sets
set.seed(1234)
data_split <- initial_split(df_model, prop = 0.8)
train_data <- training(data_split)
test_data <- testing(data_split)

# Train a linear regression model
lm_model <- lm(total_time ~ ., data = train_data)

# Predict on test data
test_results <- test_data %>%
  select(total_time) %>%
  mutate(pred_time = predict(lm_model, newdata = test_data))

# Plot predicted vs actual total time
ggplot(test_results, aes(x = total_time, y = pred_time)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, color = "black") +
  labs(title = "Predicted vs Actual Total Time",
       x = "Actual Total Time", y = "Predicted Total Time") +
  theme_minimal()

# Summarise model accuracy
# Mean Error
lm_mean_error <- mean(test_results$total_time - test_results$pred_time)
cat("Mean Error:", lm_mean_error, "\n")

# Mean Absolute Error
lm_mean_abs_error <- mean(abs(test_results$total_time - test_results$pred_time))
cat("Mean Absolute Error:", lm_mean_abs_error, "\n")

# RMSE
lm_rmse <- sqrt(mean((test_results$total_time - test_results$pred_time)^2))
cat("RMSE:", lm_rmse, "\n")

# R-squared and Adjusted R²
lm_r2 <- cor(test_results$total_time, test_results$pred_time)^2
cat("R²:", lm_r2, "\n")
cat("Adjusted R²:", summary(lm_model)$adj.r.squared, "\n")

# MAPE
lm_mape <- mean(abs((test_results$total_time - test_results$pred_time) / test_results$total_time)) * 100
cat("MAPE (%):", lm_mape, "\n")

# Residual Plot
ggplot(test_results, aes(x = pred_time, y = total_time - pred_time)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "red") +
  labs(x = "Predicted Total Time", y = "Residuals",
       title = "Residual Plot") +
  theme_minimal()

# ANOVA Table
anova_table <- anova(lm_model)
print(anova_table)

# Standardize predictors (but not target)
predictors_scaled <- df_model %>%
  select(-total_time) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), scale))  # only scale numeric columns

df_scaled <- bind_cols(predictors_scaled, total_time = df_model$total_time)

# Fit linear model on scaled data
lm_scaled <- lm(total_time ~ ., data = df_scaled)

# Extract and group coefficients
coef_df <- tidy(lm_scaled) %>%
  filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
  mutate(abs_estimate = abs(estimate),
         term_grouped = case_when(
           str_detect(term, "age_group") ~ "age_group",
           str_detect(term, "nationality") ~ "nationality",
           str_detect(term, "gender") ~ "gender",
           TRUE ~ term  # keep other terms (runs, exercises) as-is
         )) %>%
  group_by(term_grouped) %>%
  summarise(importance = mean(abs_estimate)) %>%
  arrange(desc(importance))

# Plot grouped feature importance
ggplot(coef_df, aes(x = reorder(term_grouped, importance), y = importance)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "steelblue") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Grouped Feature Importance (Standardized Coefficients)",
       x = "Feature", y = "Total Absolute Coefficient (Grouped)") +
  theme_minimal()
```
  
## Creating Random Forest Model
```{r}

# Load and filter data
df <- read.csv("hyrox_results_updated_V4.csv")

df_completed <- df %>%
  filter(completed == "Yes")

# Define predictor columns
predictors <- c(
  paste0("run_", 1:8),
  "ski_erg", "sled_push", "sled_pull", "burpee_broad_jumps",
  "rowing", "farmers_carry", "sandbag_lunges", "wall_balls",
  "gender", "nationality", "age_group"
)

# Prepare dataset
df_model <- df_completed %>%
  select(all_of(predictors), total_time) %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  mutate(
    gender = as.factor(gender),
    nationality = as.factor(nationality),
    age_group = as.factor(age_group)
  )

# Split into training and testing sets
set.seed(1234)
data_split <- initial_split(df_model, prop = 0.8)
train_data <- training(data_split)
test_data <- testing(data_split)

# Train the Random Forest model
set.seed(42)
rf_model <- randomForest(total_time ~ ., data = train_data, ntree = 500, importance = TRUE)

# Predict on test data
test_data$pred_time <- predict(rf_model, newdata = test_data)

# Plot predicted vs actual
ggplot(test_data, aes(x = total_time, y = pred_time)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, color = "black") +
  labs(title = "Predicted vs Actual Total Time (Random Forest)",
       x = "Actual Total Time", y = "Predicted Total Time") +
  theme_minimal()

# Evaluate model performance
rf_mean_error = mean(test_data$total_time - test_data$pred_time)
rf_mean_abs_error = mean(abs(test_data$total_time - test_data$pred_time))
rf_rmse <- sqrt(mean((test_data$total_time - test_data$pred_time)^2))
rf_r2 <- cor(test_data$total_time, test_data$pred_time)^2
rf_mape <- mean(abs((test_data$total_time - test_data$pred_time) / test_data$total_time)) * 100

# Print metrics
cat("Mean Error:", rf_mean_error, "\n")
cat("Mean Abs Error:", rf_mean_abs_error, "\n")
cat("RMSE:", rf_rmse, "\n")
cat("R²:", rf_r2, "\n")
cat("MAPE (%):", rf_mape, "\n")

# Compute residuals
test_data$residual <- test_data$total_time - test_data$pred_time

# Residual plot
ggplot(test_data, aes(x = pred_time, y = residual)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(title = "Residual Plot (Random Forest)",
       x = "Predicted Total Time", y = "Residual (Actual - Predicted)") +
  theme_minimal()

# Feature Importance Plot (%IncMSE)
importance_df <- as.data.frame(importance(rf_model, type = 1)) %>%
  rownames_to_column("Feature") %>%
  arrange(desc(`%IncMSE`))

ggplot(importance_df, aes(x = reorder(Feature, `%IncMSE`), y = `%IncMSE`)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "steelblue") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Random Forest Feature Importance (%IncMSE)",
       x = "Feature", y = "% Increase in MSE") +
  theme_minimal()

```

## Prediction Comparisson - Random Forest Vs Linear Model. 

**Summary Table**
```{r}
# Create summary table
model_comparison <- data.frame(
  Model = c("Linear Regression", "Random Forest"),
  RMSE = c(round(lm_rmse, 2), round(rf_rmse, 2)),
  R_squared = c(round(lm_r2, 4), round(rf_r2, 4)),
  MAPE_Percent = c(round(lm_mape, 2), round(rf_mape, 2)),
  Mean_Error = c(round(lm_mean_error, 2), round(rf_mean_error, 2)),
  Mean_Abs_Error = c(round(lm_mean_abs_error, 2), round(rf_mean_abs_error, 2))
)

# Display as nice table
knitr::kable(model_comparison, caption = "Model Performance Comparison: Linear vs Random Forest")

```
   
**Prediction Comparison Plot - Random Forest Vs Linear Model**  
```{r}
# Create a combined dataframe for prediction comparison
df_results <- test_data %>%
  select(total_time) %>%
  mutate(
    pred_lm = predict(lm_model, newdata = test_data),
    pred_rf = predict(rf_model, newdata = test_data)
  )
ggplot(df_results, aes(x = total_time)) +
  geom_point(aes(y = pred_lm, color = "Linear"), alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_point(aes(y = pred_rf, color = "Random Forest"), alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(title = "Prediction Comparison", y = "Predicted Total Time", x = "Actual Total Time", color = "Model") +
  theme_minimal()

```
